newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Employees criticise Albania TV over protests bias.
newsitem.headline: Employees criticise Albania TV over protests bias.

text.p: Staff at Albanian state-run television have criticised the station's reporting of recent unrest and anti-government demonstrations and complained of censorship, Albanian newspapers reported on Friday.

Staff at Radio Televizioni Shqiptar (RTVSH) told a meeting of their trade union that they were ashamed of what they called censored reports of protests sparked by the collapse of dubious investment schemes, the independent daily Koha Jone said.

"All the speakers said that the television reports have been unrealistic and censored," the paper added. "It is shameful for us to be employees of a single television station that is supposed to be depoliticised."
